answer_1.quote: ...We evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs ... tasks such as Summarization, Creative writing, Brainstorming, Classification, Open QA, Closed QA, Multiple choice...

answer_2.quote: ...Traditional metrics such as BLEU or ROUGE-L fail to capture this dimension... we also report BLEU and ROUGE-L for NLG tasks...

answer_3.quote: ...We used GPT‑4.1 as the judge since it shows the strongest correlation... LLM‑as‑a‑judge protocol to assess factual accuracy and reasoning... rating 1‑10...

answer_4.quote: ...We sampled 1,200 examples uniformly across all domains and task types. ... we had annotators rank the outputs from worst to best...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank model outputs from worst to best for each example.
